C.Giant browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal C.Giant OD-1 Warm Blues - Overdrive/Distortion Published on March 20, 2011 C.Giant overdrive pedal Information The C.Giant OD-1 Warm Blues Overdrive is a budget overdrive and distortion pedal designed for blues and classic rock tones. Based on the same design as the Yuyin OD-1 and Namu OD-1, it features the same internal architecture and control layout, with only branding and casing differing across models. Other near-identical versions include the Johnny Brook Warm Blues and Golden Ton OD-1. This pedal offers a four-knob control scheme: Level sets the output volume, Gain adjusts the drive intensity, Low boosts or cuts bass frequencies, and High cuts upper harmonics. This gives players flexibility to shape mid-gain tones from subtle warmth to more aggressive distortion, making it suitable for everything from clean boost to creamy solo tones. The OD-1 includes two output jacks, one sending a dry signal and the other sending the effected signal, allowing for parallel routing or flexible amp setups. Specifications match the Johnny Brook version exactly, reinforcing its OEM origins. The build is rugged enough for everyday use and power comes via a standard 9V battery or adapter.
